text: With Drake Maye preparing to lead the Patriots into their 2026 home opener against the Pittsburgh Steelers on Sunday, September 20 at 1 PM ET, the rookie quarterback faces a significant challenge: the team will be without star wide receiver A.J. Brown, who suffered a high ankle sprain in Week 1 and has been placed on injured reserve for a minimum of four games, forcing other receivers to step into larger roles as the Patriots attempt to bounce back. Off the field, Maye and his wife Ann Michael have demonstrated their commitment to the community by purchasing Amazon classroom wish lists for more than 50 teachers and support specialists at Alfred Lima Sr. Elementary School in Providence, while Robert Kraft made headlines by removing rapper Macklemore as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's upcoming Gillette Stadium shows, citing the artist's "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery" as offensive to the Jewish community. In roster moves, the Patriots re-signed safety Elliott Davison to the practice squad while releasing tight end Shane Zylstra, and the Kraft Family, Patriots Foundation, and Gillette donated $275,000 in the names of 2026 Myra Kraft Community MVP Award winners, with volunteer Susie Shaw of Carlisle receiving this year's $25,000 grand prize.
